# Patches

<!-- Generated by `just patches` from my.patches (modules/shared/patches.nix). Do not edit. -->

Temporary workarounds for upstream breakage, one module per patch under
`modules/nixos/patches/` and `modules/home/patches/`.

## brave-fullscreen-video-washout

Launches Brave with WaylandWpColorManagerV1 disabled. In fullscreen, native-Wayland Brave hands video to Hyprland through wp_color_management_v1, and Hyprland's conversion washes it out (seen with an SDR BT.709 YouTube stream, output in sRGB); windowed, Chromium converts it itself and it looks right. Without the protocol Chromium also converts fullscreen video, at the cost of HDR passthrough.

- **Module**: [`modules/home/patches/brave-fullscreen-video-washout.nix`](modules/home/patches/brave-fullscreen-video-washout.nix)
- **Also changes**: [`modules/home/desktop/browser/default.nix`](modules/home/desktop/browser/default.nix)
- **Upstream**: none known
- **Remove when**: Launched without the flag (brave --disable-features=OutdatedBuildDetector,UseChromeOSDirectVideoDecoder), a fullscreen YouTube video on Hyprland looks the same as windowed. Also drop it if an output is switched to HDR (cm = "hdr"), which the flag prevents Brave from using.
- **Added**: 2026-11-07
- **Status** (2026-11-27): Not re-tested visually. Running on GLaDOS with the flag: Hyprland 0.57.2, Brave 1.100.58, all outputs in sRGB. No matching Hyprland issue found. 0.57.2's color management fix (Hyprland #16897) concerns sdrsaturation only, per its description.
- **Active on**: evf@GLaDOS, evf@chell, evf@tardis

## hyprpaper-wait-for-hyprland

Delays hyprpaper.service until Hyprland answers IPC. Started as soon as WAYLAND_DISPLAY is set, hyprpaper found its outputs but never rendered the wallpaper on them until the service was restarted (seen on GLaDOS).

- **Module**: [`modules/home/patches/hyprpaper-wait-for-hyprland.nix`](modules/home/patches/hyprpaper-wait-for-hyprland.nix)
- **Upstream**: none known
- **Remove when**: With the ExecStartPre wait removed, the wallpaper renders at login without restarting hyprpaper.service, over a few logins.
- **Added**: 2026-08-13
- **Status** (2026-11-27): No upstream report known. Not re-tested without the wait since it was added. The lock has hyprpaper 0.8.5, whose release notes list no startup or rendering fix.
- **Active on**: evf@GLaDOS, evf@chell, evf@tardis

## kondo-nested-projects

Builds kondo from a fork (github:eliseuv/kondo, upstream master plus a --nested flag) and passes --nested in kondo-clean.service. kondo stops descending at the first directory with a project marker, so a root Cargo.toml (Cargo workspaces, the leetcode repo) hides every nested project's target or node_modules. With --nested it keeps descending, entering everything except the found projects' artifact directories.

- **Module**: [`modules/home/patches/kondo-nested-projects.nix`](modules/home/patches/kondo-nested-projects.nix)
- **Also changes**: [`flake.nix`](flake.nix), [`modules/home/core/maintenance/kondo.nix`](modules/home/core/maintenance/kondo.nix)
- **Upstream**: https://github.com/tbillington/kondo/issues/29
- **Remove when**: A kondo release in the locked nixpkgs can find nested projects (a flag like --nested, or the discovery rework of https://github.com/tbillington/kondo/issues/111). Switch the unit to that flag, then drop the override and the `kondo` flake input.
- **Added**: 2026-11-26
- **Status** (2026-11-27): Locked nixpkgs and the latest release are kondo 0.9, whose --help has no --nested. Issues #29 and #111 are open. On GLaDOS the patched kondo-clean.service run of Nov 27 00:09 cleaned 22/22 projects (762.5 MiB).
- **Active on**: dani@chell, evf@GLaDOS, evf@chell, evf@rattmann, evf@tardis, evf@wheatley

## nh-nushell-completer

Removes nh's nushell completion script, leaving nh completion to carapace. The script wraps the existing external completer in a closure taking the positional `spans`, which nushell 0.116 deprecates, and hands that list on to the previous completer; fzf's expects a record, so completing other commands fails with "Cannot find column 'command'".

- **Module**: [`modules/nixos/patches/nh-nushell-completer.nix`](modules/nixos/patches/nh-nushell-completer.nix)
- **Upstream**: https://github.com/manic-systems/climax/issues/55, https://github.com/manic-systems/climax/pull/56
- **Remove when**: share/nushell/vendor/autoload/nh.nu of the nh in the locked nixpkgs takes `place` instead of `spans`.
- **Added**: 2026-11-27
- **Status** (2026-11-27): climax #55 and #56 open. The locked nh 4.5.0 still ships an nh.nu using `spans`. nh 4.5.1 (nixpkgs #594269, not in the lock yet) still locks caress 0.3.0.
- **Active on**: GLaDOS, chell, rattmann, tardis, wheatley

## zotero-firefox-esr

Zotero is left out of home.packages. Zotero 10 runs on Firefox ESR 140, which nixpkgs dropped; the fix that landed builds it against a prebuilt Firefox 140 ESR that is marked insecure, so it doesn't evaluate without permitting that package. Don't GC the old zotero store path meanwhile, so its profile compatibility stays around.

- **Module**: [`modules/home/patches/zotero-firefox-esr.nix`](modules/home/patches/zotero-firefox-esr.nix)
- **Also changes**: [`modules/home/apps/documents/default.nix`](modules/home/apps/documents/default.nix)
- **Upstream**: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/568692, https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/572466
- **Remove when**: pkgs.zotero evaluates without permitting an insecure package (expected with Zotero 11 on Firefox ESR 153), or permitting firefox-esr-140-bin-unwrapped is accepted.
- **Added**: 2026-10-01
- **Status** (2026-11-27): The lock contains #572466 and has zotero 10.0.9, which still refuses to evaluate: it depends on insecure firefox-esr-140-bin-unwrapped-140.17.0esr.
- **Active on**: dani@chell, evf@GLaDOS, evf@chell, evf@tardis
